spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the explainer's second use case — logically sub-dividing one variable — with the real surfaces: an unsized var<storage, read> pack : buffer, *bufferView<SectionHeader>(&pack, 0u) for the directory, bufferArrayView<array<f32>>/<array<u32>> with runtime offset+size (4-byte aligned), arrayLength on the carved views, and bufferLength(&pack). The packing (header at 0, sections after) mirrors the official webgpu-samples wireframe port, and the prose repeats its robustness argument for bufferArrayView.

interactive.rationale: Two sliders repack the buffer live (layout bar, byte ranges, and CPU expected column update on input — verified via CDP: positions 12->24 changed the caption to 148 bytes and indices_offset to 112), and Pack & dispatch runs the real pipeline.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises header+f32+u32 packed into one buffer split in-shader with bufferArrayView and bufferLength; delivered, including the no-256-byte-alignment point.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinct no-WebGPU / null-adapter / compile-failure handling; CPU f32 sum uses Math.fround per step; slider edits between dispatches re-render the CPU reference and reset the GPU column to n/a so stale readbacks cannot be misread as current.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus 5094091886034944, feature page, proposal, and the webgpu-samples wireframe PR are linked.

conformance.rationale: The suite's bufferarrayview-compiles and bufferlength-compiles assertions cover this page's exact shader surfaces; the suite ran in-session with the honest matrix.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 + SwiftShader: layout bar proportions and byte ranges correct (16/48/36 at defaults; 148-byte total after slider change), CPU expected values verified by hand (max index 21 for 24 positions with (i*7+3)%24, indices_offset 112), honest unsupported panel with the real compile error, slider and dispatch driven via CDP, console clean. The GPU dispatch/readback/match path is unexecuted — no available browser lists buffer_view.

telemetry_health.rationale: bufferview-subdivision-match asserts all six readouts equal only after a real readback; bufferview-subdivision-fallback fires separately with the failure reason.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; the layout bar's emerald segment and the match cells use black text on emerald after the ivory-on-emerald draft (~4.0:1) was measured and fixed; blue segment ivory-on-blue ~7.7:1; header segment black/ivory.

accessibility.rationale: Range inputs are labelled with their live values in text, the layout bar is a figure with role=img labelled by its caption plus a text legend and title tooltips, the results table has a caption and th scope, status is aria-live=polite, and match state is textual, not colour-only.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-emulated 360x740 DPR3: scrollWidth 360; sliders and button stack full-width; the layout bar stays proportional at narrow widths with the legend carrying the labels; results table scrolls in its wrapper; full-page mobile and 1280x2100 desktop screenshots read. CLI 360 captures hit the known headless clamp; CDP was authoritative.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel layout without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use flexible proportional tracks (flex-grow ratios) for data-driven visualisations and scroll containers for wide tables.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The byte-layout bar uses flex-grow proportional to real byte counts with min-width:0 and overflow hidden per segment; the table scrolls in .tablewrap; verified zero page overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce async operation result status live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pair visual-only graphics with text equivalents and announce async outcomes politely.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The bar carries role=img + figcaption + a text legend duplicating segment meaning and byte ranges; the aria-live status reports counts, sum, and total bytes after each dispatch.

openQuestions.title: GPU carve/readback path unexecuted anywhere
openQuestions.detail: arrayLength-of-carved-view semantics (size passed at the call, not the binding) is the page's central teaching claim, and it has only been asserted from the proposal text — no available browser can run it. Verify all six readouts on a buffer_view-enabled Chrome 153+/Canary.

openQuestions.title: Workgroup address space use case not yet demoed
openQuestions.detail: The proposal also allows buffer<N> for var<workgroup> (reusing workgroup memory across phases, issue #5156). That is a distinct third use case worth its own concept page once a supporting build exists to validate against; compile-only coverage would be weak.

summary: The subdivision demo packs a real header+f32+u32 layout into one storage buffer, visualises the byte ranges to scale, and dispatches a shader that carves it with bufferArrayView and measures it with bufferLength/arrayLength, all checked against a hand-verifiable CPU reference. Interactivity, packing math, honest unsupported state, mobile parity, and clean console were verified in this session's Chromium 141; the GPU-side proof and a future workgroup-memory concept await a supporting build.
